subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjectLayer
subsystem.responsibility: Shared runtime object infrastructure for the media/surface decode path: a common allocator vtable at this+0x4, an error-reporting object reached through this+0x0, ring-buffer control blocks at this+0x188, a sub-surface descriptor array at this+0xC4 (84-byte stride) and a texture codec context at this+0x1A4. Functions in this scope validate decoder configuration, allocate per-object buffers, dispatch through indirect function tables, and manage audio ring-buffer / texture-codec state transitions.

summary: Eighteen generic runtime objects for media/surface processing. PlaneVisibilityRangeSetup (0x0051B7CD) validates a per-plane visibility range configuration, fills a 256-byte-stride lookup table, and selects one of four plane decoder callbacks. A set of audio/ring-buffer objects cooperate: SoundEffectStateCallback (0x0051BE7D) installs operation pointers (BufferedDataReader 0x0051BDF1 for read, AudioRingBufferManager 0x0051BD61 for write, RenderCommandDispatch 0x0051BCFC for idle) into the ring control block installed by PlaybackBufferAlloc (0x0051BF23); AudioBufferMixing (0x0051BFC0) flushes and copies channel data; AudioSampleStream (0x0051CD53) streams samples with a pending-sample buffer. MediaAudioDecodeDispatch (0x0051C3E2) and allocateComboBoxBuffers (0x0051BC88) allocate descriptor/buffer memory and populate routine tables. TextureCodecModeDispatch (0x0051DFCB), textureContextInit (0x0051E0DC), BlockTextureDecompression (0x0051DCAA) and GridOccupancyBoundingBoxScan (0x0051D247) share a texture codec context at this+0x1A4. ImageResampleFilter (0x0051C2DB), IndexedSurfaceBlit (0x0051C94F) and PtrInitZero (0x0051C091) are pixel/routine helpers; CombinatorialPermutationGenerator (0x0051E1EF) builds mixed-radix permutations. All objects share an allocator vtable at this+0x4 and an error-reporting object via this+0x0; the shared this-relative layout is a hypothesis, not proven ownership.

function_roles.role: Validates plane visibility range configuration, fills the 256-byte-stride per-plane lookup table, selects one of four decoder callbacks, and finalizes a decoder output object.
Allocates a per-object dispatch state block and per-object 256-byte buffers through the allocator vtable.
Render pipeline dispatcher: clamps the requested item count and dispatches process and output functions through two function tables.
Ring-buffer write path: lazily allocates the backing buffer, copies input samples, zero-fills newly covered regions and wraps on capacity.
Ring-buffer read path: lazily allocates the read buffer, clamps the copy amount and advances/wraps the read position.
Sound-effect state-transition handler that installs ring-buffer operation pointers by state and resets position counters.
Allocates the 28-byte playback ring-buffer control block and conditionally the audio data buffer (write or read variant).
Audio channel mixing: flushes active channels when the consumed count reaches the buffer total, then dispatches an indirect copy.
Trivial pointer-initializer helper: zeroes the dword at a4 and returns the pointer; a1/a2/a3 unused.
Vertical image resampler blending neighboring rows with a 3:1 weighted convolution; optional interior channel loop.
Allocates the per-surface decode descriptor and selects per-sub-surface copy routines by format flags, scale and channel count.
Row-wise per-pixel color transform through four lookup tables; SIMD+scalar hybrid or pure scalar path selected by a global render-mode flag.
Streams audio samples with a pending-sample buffer, flushing buffered samples through the block-copy routine or dispatching fresh sample pairs.
Tightens an axis-aligned bounding box by scanning the 16-bit-cell occupancy grid and returns the occupied-cell count.
Decompresses block-compressed texture rows with serpentine error diffusion driven by a dither error buffer.
Selects and installs the texture codec dispatch pair on the context object and manages dirty-row and row-count clamps.
Initializes the texture processing context: allocates the 44-byte context, row-buffer array, palette and dither buffers.
Generates and advances mixed-radix combinatorial permutations until the target count is exceeded, with optional index remap.

classes.name: MediaSurfaceObject
classes.responsibility: Large shared this-relative object behind the decoder/media-surface functions: plane visibility configuration, sub-surface descriptor array, lookup tables, stream sub-struct and texture context slots all live on this layout. The packet presents all of them as this-relative offsets (shared struct layout hypothesis); common ownership across every function is not proven.

classes.name: RingBufferManager
classes.responsibility: Read and write paths of the audio ring buffer. The 28-byte control block is reached at this+0x188 and also presented by the packet as this-relative slots (this+0x190..0x1A0); slot 1 holds the operation pointer installed by SoundEffectStateCallback.

classes.name: SoundPlaybackControl
classes.responsibility: Installs and allocates the playback ring-buffer control block: SoundEffectStateCallback selects the operation pointer by state and PlaybackBufferAlloc allocates the block and the audio data buffer.

classes.name: RenderCommandDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Generic render pipeline dispatcher reading a render-state block at this+0x188 and dispatching through two function tables (process at this+0x19C, output at this+0x1A4); also installable as the idle ring-buffer operation pointer.

classes.name: TextureProcessingContext
classes.responsibility: 44-byte texture codec context allocated at this+0x1A4 (DERIVED owner name from the packet): codec dispatch pair, row-buffer array, palette, dither buffer, toggle and symmetric-array slots. Also hosts the occupancy-grid row-array scan of GridOccupancyBoundingBoxScan.

classes.name: AllocatorProvider
classes.responsibility: Allocator object behind this+0x4 with a vtable whose entries 0, 1, 2, 4 and 7 are called with (this, 1, size) style arguments to allocate control blocks, arrays, aligned and flagged buffers.

classes.name: ErrorReporter
classes.responsibility: Error-reporting object reached through this+0x0. On validation failure the caller writes an error code at obj+0x14 with detail arguments at obj+0x18..0x24 and dispatches through the obj+0x0 vtable (secondary dispatch via obj+0x4 used for decode-mismatch reports).

classes.name: ImageResampler
classes.responsibility: Vertical image resampler blending consecutive pixel channel bytes with a 3:1 weighted convolution and an optional interior channel loop.

classes.name: PermutationGenerator
classes.responsibility: Mixed-radix combinatorial permutation generator: grows a factorial until the target count at this+0x54 is exceeded and advances positions until the total exceeds the target, with an optional global remap in mode 2.

state_machines.name: RingBufferOperationState
transitions: state0_idle -> install RenderCommandDispatch when a2==0 and flag this+0x4A set
state0_idle -> fallback pointer from *(*(this+0x19C)+4) when flag this+0x4A clear
any state -> reset position counters v3[5]/v3[6] to 0
buffer-not-allocated (v3[3]==0) -> write state 4 to obj+0x14 and invoke default method or allocator at *(this+0x4)+28

state_machines.name: RingBufferFillWrap
transitions: filling -> full when fill level reaches capacity this+0x198
full -> filling: cursor this+0x19C += capacity, fill level this+0x1A0 reset to 0
first-use (fill level 0) -> lazily allocate backing buffer via allocator at this+0x4

state_machines.name: TextureCodecMode
transitions: mode0 -> mode2 when this+0x4C is nonzero (promoted to 2)
mode2 -> allocate dither buffer (6*(this+0x5C+2)) and call SymmetricArrayInit
flag-set branch -> install TrackSurfaceHeightmapIncrement + VehicleUpdateFrameSetup and set context dirty flag this+0x1C0
flag-clear branch -> install BlockTextureDecompression (mode 2) or PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup plus nullsub_4
dirty (context+0x1C) -> zero 32 rows of 0x1000 bytes and clear flag

interfaces.name: IAllocator
interfaces.purpose: Allocator vtable reached through this+0x4; entries 0, 1, 2, 4 and 7 allocate control blocks, arrays, aligned buffers, write buffers and flagged buffers with (this, 1, size) style calls.

interfaces.name: IRingOperation
interfaces.purpose: Operation pointers installed into ring control block slot 1 by SoundEffectStateCallback: BufferedDataReader (read, state 2), AudioRingBufferManager (write, state 3) and RenderCommandDispatch (idle path).

interfaces.name: IErrorDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Error-reporting object protocol: write an error code at obj+0x14 with detail arguments at obj+0x18..0x24, then dispatch through the obj+0x0 vtable (secondary dispatch slot at obj+0x4).

interfaces.name: IDecoderRoutineSelection
interfaces.purpose: Selection of plane and sub-surface decode routines: PlaneVisibilityRangeSetup picks among four plane decoder callbacks and MediaAudioDecodeDispatch populates a per-sub-surface routine table.

interfaces.name: ITextureCodecDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Texture codec dispatch pair installed on the context object (context+4 and context+8 slots at this+0x1A8/0x1AC): TrackSurfaceHeightmapIncrement + VehicleUpdateFrameSetup, or BlockTextureDecompression/PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup + nullsub_4.

interfaces.name: IBlockCopyAndFill
interfaces.purpose: Block-copy and zero-fill utility routines used by the audio stream, texture codec and surface blit paths: F_2DArrayBlockCopy, MemoryZeroFill, BitstreamTextureBlockCopy, SymmetricArrayInit and the SIMD 8-pixel transform.

compatibility_contracts.name: RingBufferControlBlockLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: 28-byte ring control block at this+0x188: slot 0 state handler, slot 1 operation pointer, slot 2 size hint, slot 3 data pointer, slot 4 capacity, slot 5 cursor, slot 6 position/fill level. Presented by the packet both as block-relative (*(this+0x188)+0x04..0x18) and as this-relative (this+0x190..0x1A0).

compatibility_contracts.name: AllocatorVtableSlots
compatibility_contracts.description: Allocator at this+0x4 with vtable entries 0, 1, 2, 4 and 7 (offsets 0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x1C) called with a leading (this, 1) pair and a size argument.

compatibility_contracts.name: ErrorReportingObjectProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: Error reports are written as error code at obj+0x14 with up to four detail arguments at obj+0x18..0x24, then dispatched through the obj+0x0 vtable (secondary dispatch through obj+0x4).

compatibility_contracts.name: PlaneLookupTableStride
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-plane lookup-table rows are 256-byte-stride (plane index shifted left by 8) anchored at this+0x8C and filled over the range this+0x168..this+0x16C with the set value at this+0x174.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextureCodecContextLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: 44-byte texture codec context at this+0x1A4: +0x10 palette buffer, +0x14 pixel count, +0x18 row-buffer array (also occupancy-grid rows), +0x1C dirty/ready flag, +0x20 dither buffer, +0x24 toggle, +0x28 symmetric array. Sub-offsets map to this+0x1B4..0x1CC on the shared layout.

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalRenderModeFlag
compatibility_contracts.description: Global byte at 0x005D79DC selects between the SIMD+scalar hybrid path and the pure scalar path in IndexedSurfaceBlit.

unresolved: Shared-layout hypothesis: the packet presents fields of several functions as this-relative offsets (0x48-0x64, 0x5C, 0xC4, 0x110-0x124, 0x168-0x174, 0x188-0x1DC). Equal this-relative offsets reused across different functions are not proof the functions share one object; MediaSurfaceObject groups them under an explicit hypothesis (per AudioBufferMixing's existing shared-struct-layout note).
The error-reporting object at this+0x0 and the decoder output object at this+0x194 are distinct objects with similar field offsets; their type relationship is unknown.

Error codes 14, 23, 37, 46, 49, 55, 56 and 111 have meanings outside this packet that are not established; error 55 is used both as an underflow clamp in textureContextInit and as a permutation-base error in CombinatorialPermutationGenerator.

The ring control block is allocated as a separate 28-byte object by PlaybackBufferAlloc yet AudioRingBufferWrite and BufferedDataReader read its slots as this-embedded fields (this+0x190..0x1A0); which model holds is unresolved.

this+0x19C is used both as a ring/stream sub-struct pointer and as a process function table (RenderCommandDispatcher) and as the write cursor slot; the dual-role aliasing of this+0x19C/0x1A4 across functions is unresolved.
Mode flag (zero vs non-zero) and bitstream-absent flag semantics at the subsystem level are inferred from code shape, not confirmed.

Decoder callback pairs (BitstreamDecoder/sub_51B154 and PlaneVisibilityTestWithBitfieldOutput/sub_51B45F) and the nine routine-table labels (VehicleStructFieldCopy, AudioBufferMixing, SetterReturnA4, PtrInitZero, TrackMapPixelFill, MonochromeBufferByteDuplicateCopy, BufferInterleaveCopy, PixelBlendFilterHorizontal, ImageResampleFilter) are corpus labels, not runtime-proven behavior.
The 256-byte-stride per-plane lookup table layout and the 32-cell/64-byte occupancy grid geometry are inferred from pointer arithmetic, not confirmed by named structures.
The meaning of the a2[6] scaled squared-extent formula (16/12/8 coefficients) in GridOccupancyBoundingBoxScan and the dword_5B06C8 remap table in CombinatorialPermutationGenerator are unknown.
The concrete targets of the indirect copy/flush/dispatch calls (ring operation pointers, copy function tables, obj vtable entries) are not resolvable from this packet.
The packet-internal literal discrepancy (obj+0x14 underflow value 55 vs 56) in TextureCodecModeDispatch is preserved unresolved.

The allocator objects, the dispatch-state class seeded with FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT (0x0051BAD1), and the descriptor type behind *(this+0xC4) are not identified by packet evidence.
Sub-surface descriptor element flag at +0x30 and channel count at +0x28 semantics, and the meaning of the -1 dispatch-slot initialization in allocateComboBoxBuffers, are not established.
SymmetricArrayInit call target has no callee address evidence; obj+0x18 init_literal 256 field metadata appears mislabeled versus the raw allocator-result assignment.
Plane pointer semantics of a2 in IndexedSurfaceBlit (three-plane source layout) and the color-space meaning of the four lookup tables are inferred, not confirmed.
The exact block-compression palette-index transform and error-diffusion weights are recovered as arithmetic only; the intended visual algorithm is inferred.
Why PtrInitZero receives unused parameters a1/a2/a3, and which caller object it serves, is unknown.
